# and static attribution; v3 + v4: widened and carved out by the multi-combination SyncTest (docs/phase4-ggpo-state.md section 6).
# decision: include = save/restore and checksum; restore = save/restore only (state the game reads whose
#           contents also depend on interrupt timing in the emulator); exclude = not part of the state
# Save point: top of the main loop (after the previous frame's kmRender / frame_end_input_audio).
